note: Display names used across the public data (h2h_all_time.json, all_time_stats.json, history.json) and the PDFs. Manager ids never change; only the display names do. Read by build_h2h.py (and so build_all_time_stats.py), apply_history_overrides.py, build_site_data.py and build_team_stats.py.

history_json_aliases.note: history.json owner/opponent/champion names written by build_site_data.py -> display name. Current managers keep their full names in history.json because the site's team pages match history.json career rows to teams.json owners by exact full name.

site_short_names.note: Full owner name (as in teams.json 'owner', which pages match on) -> short_name shown on the site. Read by build_site_data.py (teams.json) and build_team_stats.py (team_stats.json). Full owner names are never changed.
